title: Shelter of Athkatla
summary: Clothing that gives advantage against spell saves and casts Mirror Image.

fields.Spell Resistance: Advantage on saving throws against spells.
fields.Mirror Image: Level 2, self Action once per Long Rest. Create three images for 10 turns. Each adds +3 AC. An attack that misses removes one image.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
